parsed_json.sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, di.mesh_id, di.mesh_heading, di.efo_id AS indication_curie, di.efo_term AS indication_label, di.max_phase_for_ind FROM drug_indication di JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON di.molregno = md.molregno ORDER BY md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, di.mesh_id, di.mesh_heading, di.efo_id, di.efo_term, di.max_phase_for_ind
